notifications.title: Notification preferences
notifications.intro: Choose which community events can notify you as they become available.
notifications.error: Your notification preferences could not be saved.

replies.label: Replies
replies.description: When someone replies to one of your comments.

mentions.label: Mentions
mentions.description: When someone mentions you in a community discussion.

follows.label: New followers
follows.description: When another player follows your public profile.

watchedDecks.label: Watched decks
watchedDecks.description: When a public deck you watch changes.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.intro: Keys let a program read your decks through the MagicAIBuilder API. Each key belongs to you alone and can be revoked at any time.
apiKeys.empty: No keys yet. Create one above to start using the API.

tokenOnce.title: Copy this key now — it will not be shown again
tokenOnce.body: Only a hash of the key is stored, so nobody, including us, can show it to you a second time. If you lose it, revoke it and create another.
